title: CYCLEALIGN: ITERATIVE DISTILLATION FROM BLACK-BOX LLM TO WHITE-BOX MODELS FOR BETTER HUMAN ALIGNMENT
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models with human values, specifically evaluating 'harmlessness' and 'helpfulness'. The framework is benchmarked on the HH-RLHF dataset, and the evaluation includes a definition of harmlessness as content that is ethical and respectful, along with case studies discussing ethical standards and lawful behavior.
